COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
31.10.2025 C 528 No.1929 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This Application has been filed for 
quashing the entire proceedings of 
Criminal Case No.7904 of 2024, “State 
vs. Varun Kochar”, pending before the 
court of Ist Additional Chief Judicial 
Magistrate, Dehradun under Sections 
344, 420 and Section 506 of the Indian 
Penal Code, 1860.
2. Heard Mr. Trilok Chandra, learned 
counsel with Mr. Lakshay Garg, learned 
counsel for the applicant and Mrs. Sweta 
Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for 
the respondent nos.1 to 3.
3. Mr. Trilok Chandra, Advocate 
submitted that no case under Sections 
344, 420 & Section 506 of the Indian 
Penal Code, 1860 are made out against 
the applicant. 
4. Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, Brief 
Holder has sought two weeks’ time to file 
counter affidavit in the present fresh 
matter. 
5. Notice is being issued to the 
respondent no.4. Steps to be taken by all  the permissible modes within four days, 
as prayed.
6. On the joint request, list on 
12.11.2025.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
JKJ/Neha 31.10.2025
